title: USB auto-detach can leave the system driver detached after failed claim
summary: A privileged failed claim left no Mass Storage child. Public kernel reattach restored it; explicit detach/claim/release/reattach now has transactional ownership and three rollback regressions pass. Next: retain verified repair disposition and physical-test limitations.

resolution.evidence: 20261026212631-884a-complete-pentax/findings.md; verification.md and 31-case normal/ASan/UBSan logs; independent scoped security/quality reports. Physical acceptance remains blocked.
